title: Inside Greece's new AI Act framework
headline: Greece establishes EU AI Act framework under Law 5321/2026
summary: Greece established its national governance, innovation and enforcement framework for the EU AI Act through Law 5321/2026. Rather than creating a standalone AI authority, the law distributes oversight among existing sectoral regulators and designates the Hellenic Data Protection Authority as the market surveillance authority.
why_it_matters: Organisations operating across jurisdictions must understand how European member states leverage existing data protection regulators to enforce AI obligations rather than establishing new standalone bodies.

quotes.text: Greece established its national governance, innovation and enforcement framework for the EU AI Act through Law 5321/2026 , which distributes oversight among existing sectoral regulators rather than creating a standalone AI authority.
Greece has designated the Hellenic Data Protection Authority as its market surveillance authority for prohibited AI practices, Annex III high-risk systems and Article 50 transparency obligations.

classification.significance_reason: Provides an international precedent for EU AI Act national implementation, though with indirect relevance to Australian practice.
